body_text:
As she passed by the restroom, something caught her eye—a bright, colorful poster pinned to the bulletin board just outside the door. Curiously, she stepped closer, her eyes scanning the words.




"FAREWELL PARTY FOR EMILY! 🎉
Tonight at Christine’s house! Be there to give her the send-off she deserves!"

Emily blinked in surprise before a small laugh escaped her lips.

chuckling "Seriously? These guys..."

She shook her head, amused by her friends’ efforts. She hadn’t even officially agreed to a farewell party, yet here it was—planned, announced, and most likely already in motion.

smiling to herself "They’re too much."

A warmth spread through her chest. It was kind of cute how much they cared. Even though she was leaving, at least she knew she had amazing friends who wanted to make her last days here special.

With a final glance at the poster, Emily pushed open the restroom door, still smiling to herself.
